description: Single storey rear extension and front porch involving change to front elevation with rear dormer and front rooflights.
decision_conditions: The proposed rear dormer by reason of its bulk, mass, scale and detail design  would appear visually intrusive, incongruous, overly dominant, out of keeping with the character and appearance of the host building and the surrounding area of which it forms part, contrary to Policies DP3 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2026), D3 and D4 of the London Plan (2021), CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), DMD6, DMD8, DMD13 and DMD37 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014) and Policy HW-12 of the Hadley Wood Neighbourhood Plan (2023).

The single-storey rear extension by reason of its depth, height and proximity to the site boundaries would result in an unacceptable loss of light, outlook, and a heightened sense of enclosure detrimental to the occupiers of the adjoining property at Nos. 94 and 98 Lancaster Avenue contrary to Policies DP3 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2026), D3 and D4 of the London Plan (2021), CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), DMD8 and DMD11 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).
